subject: featureCounts returns exit code zero when given bad annotation file

messages.author: f24b6672b86b41b4
messages.subject: featureCounts returns exit code zero when given bad annotation file
parts:
Hi Wei,

When I submit jobs to my HPC, I check the exit codes after they run. Based on the exit code, I log whether the job was a success or failure. I thought I had successfully run a bunch of featureCounts jobs this morning, but it turns out the jobs failed but still returned exit code 0. The error was that the annotation file was bad (I had moved the annotation file but not updated the symlink to point to the new location).

Normally when I give featureCounts bad input, it properly exits with an error code, e.g.

$ featureCounts nonsense 2> /dev/null
$ echo $?
255

However, when I give it a bad annotation file, it returns exit code 0.

$ featureCounts -a nonsense -F SAF -o output bam/19098.1.A01.ATTAGACG.L002.R1.C6WYKACXX.trim.bam 2> error.txt
$ echo $?
0
$ tail -n 2 error.txt
|| Load annotation file nonsense ...                                          ||
Failed to open the annotation file nonsense, or its format is incorrect, or it contains no 'exon' features.

Why does featureCounts return 0 when there it encounters an error?

Thanks,

John
